result.reason: The clause exceeds rather than implements the playbook: it effectively requires $5M of combined professional/technology E&O and cyber coverage, while the preferred position is $2M E&O and $5M cyber only for vendors processing Customer Data. It also adds unsupported requirements for A- rated insurers, additional-insured status, waiver of subrogation, primary/non-contributory coverage, 30 days’ notice, and a non-limitation-of-liability statement. These additions are not necessary to reach either the preferred or fallback position and materially alter unrelated risk allocation. The drafting also conflates E&O and cyber coverage, uses shorthand limits, and creates duplicative notice obligations.
